## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre completed 47 captures during November 2019. Activity was delivered through the usual site arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported volume provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

A total of 5 captures were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 10.6 of all captures. The result should be considered alongside the overall activity level when reviewing image acquisition and identifying any need for operational follow-up. The available information does not indicate any interruption to planned sessions beyond routine leave.

## Grading

There were 6 referable results during November 2019. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This indicates that grading was generally completed with limited delay during the reporting period. The activity, image-quality, and grading measures should be reviewed together to support ongoing monitoring of service delivery at Hill Counties Health Centre.
